description: Source code for the Lua standard operating system library (loslib.c), providing OS-related functions such as execute, remove, rename, getenv, date, time, and locale settings.

methods.name: os_pushresult
methods.description: Pushes the result of a system call onto the Lua stack, indicating success or failure, and providing error details if failed.

methods.name: os_remove
methods.description: Removes a file specified by filename.

methods.name: os_rename
methods.description: Renames a file from one name to another.

methods.name: os_getenv
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable.

methods.name: os_clock
methods.description: Returns the CPU time used by the program.

methods.name: os_date
methods.description: Returns date and time information based on a format string.

methods.name: os_time
methods.description: Returns the current time or a time based on a provided table.

methods.name: os_difftime
methods.description: Returns the difference in seconds between two times.
